harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured resilient static routing. The direct 10.200.0.0/30 transit is preferred at metric 10; VyOS fallback uses lan-a 10.201.0.0/30 and lan-b 10.202.0.0/30 at metric 100. Final failover converged in 4.019 seconds, source addresses were preserved, direct routing was re-preferred after restoration, and all nodes passed serial restart recovery.
actions_performed: Configured persistent endpoint addresses and metric-separated static routes.
Enabled symmetric direct-peer monitoring for silent or one-sided failures.
Configured persistent VyOS forwarding only between lan-a and lan-b, with management excluded.
Verified preferred routing, fallback, source preservation, and restoration.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Preferred direct routing and source preservation
evidence.summary: Both endpoints select enp8s0 via metric-10 routes while retaining sources 10.201.0.2 and 10.202.0.2; final direct traffic had zero loss.
A one-sided direct-interface failure converged in 4.019 seconds. Both endpoints selected their enp9s0 VyOS routes, traffic succeeded with TTL 63, and VyOS forwarding counters increased.

evidence.requirement: Prefer direct path again after restoration
evidence.summary: The restored interface returned up; both endpoints ultimately selected the metric-10 transit routes and direct TTL-64 traffic succeeded.

evidence.requirement: Management network excluded from routed data plane
evidence.summary: VyOS has a default-drop forwarding policy allowing only eth1↔eth2. Endpoint traffic uses enp8s0 normally and enp9s0 during fallback, never management enp1s0/eth0.
Boot ID changed from 7668189d-21f0-4471-b90b-30e7498d3d90 to dae7779b-eec0-4fe0-9139-b0f13f221db6. VyOS configuration, forwarding, endpoint reachability, and fallback traffic recovered.
Boot ID changed from 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 to aac4435c-9d24-4eb6-8aa0-cce8e38c1690. Addresses, both routes, monitoring, and endpoint traffic recovered.
Boot ID changed from 29011044-5356-46eb-ba9c-1470170355a7 to dd20ded4-6303-4f24-b5f6-8dc36ee46734. Addresses, both routes, monitoring, and endpoint traffic recovered.
